check_text:
protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 warning).

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: A pipette too small to mix tube A1 in slot 3: 20 ul at most in 240
ul
   line 38:  p20.mix(10, 10, target_tube)
   At line 38 the tip mixes tube A1 in slot 3 with 10 strokes of 10 ul in a well holding 240
   ul. The P20 can draw at most 20 ul, under a fifth of the well: no stroke it can make will
   mix this well, however many times. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three
   mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the
   concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix with a bigger pipette (a P300 for this well): at least 5 strokes of 192 ul,
   `mix(5, 192, well)`.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [fa237ed9b950]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.

findings.title: A pipette too small to mix tube A1 in slot 3: 20 ul at most in 240 ul
findings.explanation: At line 38 the tip mixes tube A1 in slot 3 with 10 strokes of 10 ul in a well holding 240 ul. The P20 can draw at most 20 ul, under a fifth of the well: no stroke it can make will mix this well, however many times. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix with a bigger pipette (a P300 for this well): at least 5 strokes of 192 ul, `mix(5, 192, well)`.
